// divguard:path ai/anthropic.go

package ai

type StopReason string

const (
	StopReasonStop   StopReason = "stop"
	StopReasonLength StopReason = "length"
	StopReasonError  StopReason = "error"
)

// mapAnthStopReason reproduces AI-01: model_context_window_exceeded ends the
// turn as a clean stop with no error and no compaction.
func mapAnthStopReason(reason string) StopReason {
	switch reason {
	case "end_turn":
		return StopReasonStop
	case "max_tokens":
		return StopReasonLength
	default: // want
		return StopReasonStop
	}
}

type builder struct{}

func (b *builder) done(StopReason, string) {}

// finish reproduces AI-05 and AI-06.
func finish(b *builder, reason StopReason, data string) {
	if reason == "" { // want
		reason = StopReasonStop
	}
	if data == "[DONE]" { // want
		b.done(StopReasonStop, "")
		return
	}
	b.done(reason, "")
}
